description.en:
Places an object at once. Two forms:
- separate numbers (x, y, z, direction): missing ones are 0 and the direction is in degrees;
- an array [x, y, z, direction] (at most 4 values; missing ones keep their current value): here the fourth value is stored as is, without the degree conversion, so it is taken as radians.
Images use the same command with [x, y] screen coordinates. For characters that the movement helpers drive, also call CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG to the same spot (as SetCharaPosAndMotName does).

true once placed.
null if the object is not found, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Separate numbers (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, SetCharaPosAndMotName)
An array for a bust-up image (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, CreateBustup)
